Metadata.description: Clothing repair and alteration workshop. We shorten, alter and repair your clothes. Track your order online.

Home.title: Clothing alterations and repairs
Home.intro: Trousers too long, a broken zipper or a jacket that doesn't fit right? Bring it in. We help you quickly and with care.

Services.title: Services
Services.intro: We do all kinds of clothing repairs and alterations. The price depends on the garment and the work.
Services.otherTitle: Your job is not on the list?
Services.otherText: Visit the shop or send us a WhatsApp. We are happy to see what is possible.

HowItWorks.title: How it works
HowItWorks.intro: No app to install and no account needed.
HowItWorks.step1Text: Come to the shop and tell us what needs to be done.
HowItWorks.step2Text: You get a receipt with an order number and a QR code.
HowItWorks.step3Text: Scan the QR code with your phone to see the status. This is optional.
HowItWorks.step4Text: When it's ready, we send you a WhatsApp message. You can pick it up in the shop.

Track.title: Track your order
Track.intro: You can track your order in two ways:
Track.optionQr: Scan the QR code on your receipt with your phone camera.
Track.optionLink: Or open the link we sent you via WhatsApp.
Track.noCode: Lost your receipt or link? Contact us and we will help you.

Privacy.title: Privacy
Privacy.intro: We handle your data with care and only collect what is needed.
Privacy.collectText: Your name, phone number and information about your order (such as the type of work, price and date).
Privacy.purposeText: To process your order and let you know when your clothes are ready. We do not share your data with others and do not use it for advertising.
Privacy.trackingText: The link on your receipt is unique and hard to guess. The tracking page only shows your first name, order number and status. Your phone number is never shown there.
Privacy.rightsText: You can always ask which data we have about you, or ask us to correct or delete it. Just contact us.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.text: This page does not exist. Check the link or go back to the homepage.

AdminLogin.title: Log in
AdminLogin.wrongPassword: The password is not correct. Please try again.
AdminLogin.notConfigured: Login is not set up yet. Add ADMIN_PASSWORD and AUTH_SECRET to .env.local.

Dashboard.title: Overview
Dashboard.attentionHint: The ready date is today or has passed.

Orders.title: Orders
Orders.searchLabel: Search by name, phone or order number
Orders.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No orders found.} one {# order} other {# orders}}

OrderDetail.name: Name
OrderDetail.createdText: Write this number on the receipt and on the garment's tag.
OrderDetail.otherStatusHint: Chose the wrong one by mistake? Set the status back here.
OrderDetail.trackingText: The customer can scan this QR code or open the link. The customer only sees first name, order number, description and status.
OrderDetail.whatsappHint: WhatsApp opens with this message in the customer's language. You only need to press send.

NewOrder.title: New order
NewOrder.intro: Only name and phone number are needed. You can fill in the rest later.
NewOrder.name: Customer name
NewOrder.language: Language for messages to the customer
NewOrder.nameTooLong: The name is too long (maximum 100 characters).
NewOrder.phoneInvalid: This phone number is not valid. Please check it.

EditOrder.title: Edit order #{number}
EditOrder.intro: Fill in what you know. You can complete empty fields later.
EditOrder.clothingTypeHint: For example trousers, jacket or dress.
EditOrder.publicDescriptionHint: Short text the customer sees on the tracking page, for example "Trouser hem".
EditOrder.internalNoteHint: Shop only: measurements, agreements. The customer never sees this.
EditOrder.serviceInvalid: Choose a service from the list.
EditOrder.priceInvalid: Enter a valid amount, for example 15.50.

Tracking.title: Your order
Tracking.RECEIVED: We have received your clothes. We will start working on them soon.
Tracking.IN_PROGRESS: We are working on your clothes.
Tracking.READY_FOR_PICKUP: Your clothes are ready! You can pick them up in the shop.
Tracking.DELIVERED: You have picked up your clothes. Thank you!
Tracking.CANCELLED: This order has been cancelled. Questions? Please contact us.
Tracking.pickupText: Bring your receipt or order number to the shop.
Tracking.privacyNote: This page can only be seen with your personal link. Please do not share the link.
